A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the microstructure transformation is mainly realized by the aluminium matrix's plastic deformation and the interaction between the reinforcer and the matrix.

the law of the microstructural evolution of the SiCp/Al composite in hot plastic forming based on powder metallurgical process is studied,and it is concluded that the plastic deformation in the composite is realized through the aluminium alloy matrix' plastic deformation.
the microstructure of the composite is transformed from the initial state into the deformed state in hot plastic forming,and the reinforcers are oriented in the direction that the matrix is deformed.

the microstructure transformation law of SiC p /Al composite in hot plastic forming can provide the theoretical foundation for the hot plastic forming of SiC p/al composite.
